title: Earth and Seas
text: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.

title: According to Its Kind
text: … trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

title: Two Great Lights
text: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.

title: Great Sea Creatures
text: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves …

title: In His Image
text: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.

title: The Seventh Day
text: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it …

title: Every Green Plant
text: … I have given every green plant for food.

title: How Many Are Your Works
text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

title: The Heavens Declare
text: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

title: This Far and No Farther
text: You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop
